title: Not just passengers: Phages as agents of genetic exchange in fecal microbiota transplantation
authors: Belen Gonzalez Pastor, Andrey N. Shkoporov, Colin Hill
abstract: When fecal microbiota transplants (FMTs) are performed, donor bacteriophages travel along for the ride. title: Vaginal microbiota transfer ameliorates cesarean-associated neurodevelopmental deficits in mice via N-bc2S1P synthesis on neonatal skin
authors: Hao Liu, Huiling Shang, Hui Chen, Chuhui Zhou, Bin Luo, Di Zhao, Zhengxiu Xiao, Yimin Cui, Yuhang Zhang, Ri-hua Xie
abstract: Liu et al. show that vaginal microbiota transfer after cesarean birth restores a skin lipid signal linked to neurodevelopment. In mice, engineered skin bacteria sustain this microbial molecule and prolong rescue of cesarean-associated deficits.
